segments.ja450:1.3: Kimeva tvaṃ pacamāno, yaṃ na dajjā na taṃ samaṃ.
segments.ja450:2.1: Maccherā ca pamādā ca, evaṃ dānaṃ na diyyati;
segments.ja450:3.1: Yasseva bhīto na dadāti maccharī, tadevādadato bhayaṃ;
segments.ja450:3.3: Jighacchā ca pipāsā ca, yassa bhāyati maccharī;
segments.ja450:3.5: Tameva bālaṃ phusati, asmiṃ loke paramhi ca.
segments.ja450:4.1: Tasmā vineyya maccheraṃ, dajjā dānaṃ malābhibhū;
segments.ja450:6.1: Tasmā satañca asataṃ [asatañca (sī. syā. pī.)], nānā hoti ito gati;
segments.ja450:7.3: Appasmā dakkhiṇā dinnā, sahassena samaṃ mitā.
segments.ja450:8.1: Dhammaṃ care yopi samuñchakaṃ care, dārañca posaṃ dadamappakasmiṃ [dadaṃ appakasmipi (pī.)];
segments.ja450:8.3: Sataṃ sahassānaṃ sahassayāginaṃ, kalampi nāgghanti tathāvidhassa te.
segments.ja450:9.1: Kenesa yañño vipulo mahagghato [mahaggato (saṃ. ni.1.32)], samena dinnassa na agghameti;
segments.ja450:9.3: Kathaṃ sataṃ sahassānaṃ [kathaṃ sahassānaṃ (sī. syā. pī.)] sahassayāginaṃ, kalampi nāgghanti tathāvidhassa te.
segments.ja450:10.1: Dadanti heke visame niviṭṭhā, chetvā [jhatvā (sī. pī.), ghatvā (syā.)] vadhitvā atha socayitvā;
segments.ja450:10.3: Sā dakkhiṇā assumukhā sadaṇḍā, samena dinnassa na agghameti;
segments.ja450:10.5: Evaṃ sataṃ sahassānaṃ [evaṃ sahassānaṃ (sī. syā. pī.)] sahassayāginaṃ, kalampi nāgghanti tathāvidhassa teti.
